correctness.rationale: Pick and Ehrhart give the exact quadratic and finite discriminant table. The published hollow flatness and isominwidth theorems exclude all but two low-area primitive triangular cases. A complete Hermite normal form reduction at determinants 7 and 9, exact direction arguments, and unimodular equivalence prove the unique width-three exception. The standalone checker passed independent exact finite checks.

value.rationale: The motivating width-real-rootedness theorem has only a nonconstructive potentially huge threshold; exact planar sharpness plus complete uniqueness of a natural small exceptional orbit, including exclusion of repeated roots, supplies the first useful precise dimension-two boundary. It is a motivated complete finite-cutoff classification rather than an arbitrary computation.
